summary: Israel prepared to strike Iran last weekend but the U.S. requested a delay and signaled a possible joint operation later, while the IDF killed two senior Hamas commanders in Gaza and conducted extensive artillery shelling across southern Lebanon. A drone launched from Israel into Gaza was downed near Nahal Oz, and Israeli troops shot dead two Palestinian gunmen at a Hebron checkpoint. Lebanon's Red Alert system recorded 156 alerts and 89 drone sightings on October 25, including one drone strike and four airstrikes.
key_points: Israel prepared to attack Iran recently but the U.S. asked to wait and signaled a joint operation later, with U.S. forces ready to strike within 96 hours of a Trump order. (Source: @amitsegal/66169)

The IDF killed Hamas intelligence officer Mohammed Halawa in Gaza City on Saturday and engineering officer Ahmed Zahir Fuad Abu-Odeh on Thursday, stating they violated the ceasefire by restoring Hamas capabilities. (Source: @manniefabian/59430)

Lebanese Red Alert recorded 156 alerts and 89 drone sightings on Oct 25, with 37 artillery shelling incidents across 15 locations, one drone strike on Kfar Tibnit, and four airstrikes. (Source: @redlinkleb/49993)
A drone attempting to fly from Israel into Gaza was downed near Kibbutz Nahal Oz; the IDF says it was a DJI Flycart model capable of carrying dozens of kilograms. (Source: @manniefabian/59429)
Israeli troops shot dead two Palestinian gunmen who attacked a checkpoint on the northern outskirts of Hebron in the West Bank. (Source: @manniefabian/59426)
The IDF launched an interceptor missile at a suspicious aerial target over southern Lebanon where troops were operating; no sirens sounded. (Source: @manniefabian/59427)
A high-level security summit between the Mecca Alliance and Iran took place in Tehran, led by Iran's SNSC Secretary Mohsen Rezaee and the Saudi defence delegation. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8922)
Israel signed an agreement to supply Cyprus with a new offshore patrol vessel built by Israel Shipyards with Rafael systems, upgrading an existing vessel. (Source: @manniefabian/59431)

points: A high-level security summit between the Mecca Alliance and Iran convened in Tehran, led by Iran's Supreme National Security Council Secretary Major General Mohsen Rezaee and a Saudi defence delegation. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8922)

CNN reports Israel prepared to attack Iran in recent days but the U.S. asked to wait and signaled a joint operation later; the U.S. military is ready to strike Iran within 96 hours of a Trump order. (Source: @amitsegal/66169, @yediotnews25/136783)

Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz categorically denied any intention to initiate an attack on Iran before Israeli elections, stating Israel would respond forcefully if Iran attacks. (Source: @amitsegal/66167)

An explosion occurred on the fourth floor of a four-story building in the Narmak neighborhood of eastern Tehran; fire brigades reported no casualties and an initial assessment indicated a gas leak. (Source: @shin_persian/11562)

The IDF launched an interceptor missile toward a suspicious aerial target over southern Lebanon where troops were operating; no sirens sounded as no threat to civilians was assessed. (Source: @manniefabian/59427)

Two Hamas commanders were killed in recent Israeli strikes: Mohammed Halawa, a Hamas intelligence officer, killed Saturday in Gaza City; Ahmed Zahir Fuad Abu-Odeh, an engineering officer, killed Thursday. (Source: @manniefabian/59430, @yediotnews25/136791)
Israeli troops shot dead two Palestinian gunmen who attacked a checkpoint on the northern outskirts of Hebron in the West Bank. (Source: @manniefabian/59426)

Israel and Cyprus signed a defense agreement for Israel Shipyards to build a new offshore patrol vessel fitted with Rafael naval systems, and to upgrade Cyprus's existing Israeli-built OPV. (Source: @manniefabian/59431)

Prime Minister Netanyahu's office denied a CNN report as fake news; Defense Minister Katz rejected claims of gaps between the political echelon and the IDF on Iran. (Source: @amitsegal/66172, @amitsegal/66167)
An Israeli lawyer was charged with contact with a foreign agent and obstruction of investigation, described as another security affair. (Source: @amitsegal/66186)

A drone launched from Israel toward Gaza was downed near Kibbutz Nahal Oz; the IDF is investigating its payload, noting frequent smuggling attempts via drones from Israel into Gaza. (Source: @manniefabian/59429)

Footage shows Israeli troops shooting dead two Palestinian gunmen who attacked a checkpoint on the northern outskirts of Hebron in the West Bank on Friday. (Source: @manniefabian/59426)

sections.threat_assessment: The convergence of Israeli strike preparations against Iran, U.S. restraint coupled with readiness for joint action, and ongoing kinetic operations in Gaza and Lebanon indicates a high-risk, multi-front escalation trajectory. Iran's engagement with a Saudi-led alliance in Tehran suggests diplomatic maneuvering amid military pressure. The downing of a heavy-payload drone from Israel to Gaza reveals persistent smuggling routes and potential for weapon transfers. Hezbollah's artillery absorption in southern Lebanon and IDF interceptor use signal continued low-intensity conflict with potential for miscalculation. Hamas command decapitation may degrade but not eliminate operational capacity in Gaza.
sections.regional_response: Saudi Arabia's participation in a Tehran security summit with Iran's top security official marks a notable diplomatic shift, possibly aimed at de-escalation or defining red lines. The U.S. restraining Israel while positioning forces for a 96-hour strike window reflects a calibrated deterrence posture. Cyprus deepening naval ties with Israel extends regional security architecture into the Eastern Mediterranean. Lebanon's Red Alert data transparency indicates civil society resilience amid persistent bombardment. Gulf states' maritime warnings and Riyadh emergency alerts highlight sensitivity to spillover.
sections.intelligence_notes: The DJI Flycart drone incident confirms adaptation of commercial heavy-lift UAVs for cross-border payload delivery, a tactic previously seen on Jordanian and Egyptian borders. The 100% targeting ratio after drone detection in Lebanon suggests effective IDF strike coordination or limited Hezbollah air defense. The Mecca Alliance-Iran summit's composition — Mohsen Rezaee and Saudi defence — implies strategic dialogue beyond tactical coordination. Israel's Cyprus OPV deal signals long-term maritime domain awareness investment. The absence of Syrian/Iraq kinetic reports may reflect reporting gaps rather than inactivity.
